address: FIVE Palm Jumeirah - No 1 Palm Jumeirah, Dubai
bio: Fashionable, glamorous and full of energy, this buzzing Italian restaurant overlooks the trendy FIVE Palm Jumeirah’s swimming pool. Arched ceilings are complemented by warm lighting and a self-playing piano keeps everyone entertained. The menu offers up a mix of classic Italian favourites, such as parmigiana di melanzane and fassona tartare with white truffle, along with more modern interpretations, like their dessert version of a Bellini cocktail. The terrace is a great spot for alfresco dining during Dubai’s cooler weather....
